about: Character art sources and how each form is pre-sized onto the shared 640x960 canvas. Tron is the reference (his files are used as they are). Each other form's transform is measured against Tron's head (node scripts/presize-art.mjs --measure) and baked into public/assets/img/ by node --experimental-websocket scripts/presize-art.mjs. See docs/design-system.md, Character sizing. A form can set its own WebP quality (default 82).

princess.why: her art fills more of its canvas

blobfish.why: drawn smaller, and sits right in its image because the rod and catch fill the left. Balanced on the whole silhouette (catch included) rather than the head: scale 1.1 is the largest that fits all four variants inside the 640x960 canvas with an 8px margin (x 10-629), centred, with its lowest point kept at y 896 as before. (It used to be 1.18, which spilled 66px past the left edge and 28px over the top.)
